parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is a small lever or handle made of stainless steel, typically located at the base of the faucet.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to adjust water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet that connects the spout and switch, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal water channels and provides structural support for the faucet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved tube extending from the frame, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of water from the faucet to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
